votes.motion: Approval of the meeting minutes of May 6, 2025, and May 20, 2025
votes.description: The Board approved the meeting minutes from May 6, 2025 and May 20, 2025, noting a scrivener's error in the agenda that had listed May 5, 2025 instead of May 6, 2025.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 12 of 2025 approving an amendment to the 2008 Palmer Court loan
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution to assign and modify the terms of a 2008 $3,000,000 loan agreement between the CRA and Shelter the Homeless II, LC. (operated by The Road Home), enabling the redevelopment of Palmer Court at 999 South Main Street and the construction of a new affordable residential development, Gardens at Palmer.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 13 of 2025, Amended and Restated Lease for Delta Center
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution to amend and restate the lease for the Delta Center, securing long-term public benefits while keeping the land publicly owned, in connection with Smith Entertainment Group's plan to develop a culture and convention district.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property, and attorney-client matters
votes.description: The Board voted to enter a closed session to discuss real property transactions and attorney-client privileged matters pursuant to the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
The Board voted to conclude the closed session and return to open session.
